capabilities: Display visited countries on a globe or flat map, shaded by recency
Record visit years and optional notes per country
Create trips with dates, status, and linked vault notes
Generate trips automatically from travel folders named like Place 2026
Embed maps in notes with a worldmap code block
disambiguation: Not a general map or location plugin for note content; it only tracks countries visited and trips, with no coordinates or place markers.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory, so it must be installed manually from releases. The README documents privacy behaviour: it reads only note paths (never contents) and makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: The community plugin Visited Countries covers similar ground. World Map adds a globe, trips with linked notes
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualise travel history or connect past and planned trips to the notes about them.

relations.evidence: The community plugin Visited Countries covers similar ground.

summary: Interactive globe and flat world map that records visited countries and years, and links trips to the notes written during them.
